name: Lightwell Demo — Known CVE Watch
description: Flags images containing CVE-2022-40152, a denial-of-service vulnerability in Woodstox XML parsing that is exploitable with a tiny crafted payload.
rationale: CVE-2022-40152 allows denial-of-service via deeply nested DTD element declarations in XML input. The Lightwell Network remediated version (6.0.3.rhlw-00001) adds a recursion depth limit.
remediation: Replace woodstox-core 6.0.3 with the Lightwell Network remediated version 6.0.3.rhlw-00001.
